title: Versioned Next.js snippet set with labels
note: Proven offline by `tests/test_corpus.py` (62 passed) and `tests/fixtures/corpus_expected.jsonl`: 246 records with the eight keys in order and the declared types; ids c1..c246 unique, contiguous and pattern-matching; router/status/source within the allowed sets; text non-empty with every body <= 2,000 chars; all 17 official paths equal `sources.json`'s set; forum records are exactly `forum.jsonl` (17, `synthetic: true`, `legacy`, `forum/` paths); committed labels reproduced from `label_rules.json` (21 legacy, every one matched by a rule with a reason); splitter and `assemble_records` byte-identical across two runs against the 13-record snapshot; `--check` exits 0 from a subprocess (246 chunks, app=196 pages=50, legacy=21, forum=17, `check: ok`) and each of its failure branches has a named test; only `corpus/fetch.py` imports an HTTP module (`httpx`, Daniel's approved departure from stdlib urllib). Unproven: embedding-value determinism — it needs model calls and is outside this offline slice; `--check` verifies npy row count, order, width, model, count and the chunks hash, not the vector values.

title: FastAPI service holding the pipeline and its per-query trace
note: Covered by `tests/test_api.py` (20 passed). Untested criterion: `/health` with a missing `.npy`.

title: Gate 1: in-scope check, version routing, injection refusal
note: Covered by `tests/test_scope.py` (20 passed). Untested criteria: scope threshold boundary 0.50, injection precedence order, bad-router 502.

title: BM25 + dense retrieval returning ~30 chunks with fused ranking
note: Covered by `tests/test_retrieve.py` (20 passed). Untested criteria: 24-chunk short slice, embedding-call count.

title: Gate 2: per-chunk relevance/currency scoring, threshold, zero-pass stop
note: Covered by `tests/test_rerank.py` (20 passed). Untested criterion: decision-call question count.
